trace.request: For every athlete in the countermovement-jump test table, return the athlete id, the jump height (cm) at their first test (earliest date) and at their latest test (latest date), and the change (latest minus first). Include the number of tests per athlete.

args.query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT athlete, MIN(test_index) AS first_idx, MAX(test_index) AS last_idx, COUNT(*) AS n_tests
  FROM tests GROUP BY athlete
)
SELECT f.athlete, f.n_tests,
  (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.first_idx) AS first_jump_cm,
  (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.last_idx) AS last_jump_cm,
  (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.last_idx)
   - (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.first_idx) AS change_cm
FROM f
ORDER BY f.athlete
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT athlete) AS n_athletes, COUNT(*) AS n_tests FROM tests

WITH f AS (
  SELECT athlete, MIN(test_index) AS first_idx, MAX(test_index) AS last_idx, COUNT(*) AS n_tests
  FROM tests GROUP BY athlete
)
SELECT f.athlete, f.n_tests,
  (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.first_idx) AS first_jump_cm,
  (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.last_idx) AS last_jump_cm,
  ROUND((SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.last_idx)
   - (SELECT jump_mean_cm FROM tests t WHERE t.athlete = f.athlete AND t.test_index = f.first_idx), 2) AS change_cm
FROM f
ORDER BY f.athlete
LIMIT 70 OFFSET 194

  FROM tests t
  JOIN (SELECT athlete, MIN(test_index) AS mi FROM tests GROUP BY athlete) m
    ON t.athlete = m.athlete AND t.test_index = m.mi
),
l AS (
  SELECT t.athlete, t.jump_mean_cm AS last_cm, t.test_date AS last_date
  FROM tests t
  JOIN (SELECT athlete, MAX(test_index) AS ma FROM tests GROUP BY athlete) m
    ON t.athlete = m.athlete AND t.test_index = m.ma
)
SELECT f.athlete, f.first_date, f.first_cm, l.last_date, l.last_cm,
       ROUND(l.last_cm - f.first_cm, 2) AS change_cm
FROM f JOIN l ON f.athlete = l.athlete
ORDER BY change_cm DESC
LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT athlete) AS n_athletes, COUNT(*) AS n_tests FROM tests

WITH f AS (SELECT t.athlete, t.jump_mean_cm AS first_cm, t.test_date AS first_date FROM tests t JOIN (SELECT athlete, MIN(test_index) AS mi FROM tests GROUP BY athlete) m ON t.athlete = m.athlete AND t.test_index = m.mi),
l AS (SELECT t.athlete, t.jump_mean_cm AS last_cm, t.test_date AS last_date FROM tests t JOIN (SELECT athlete, MAX(test_index) AS ma FROM tests GROUP BY athlete) m ON t.athlete = m.athlete AND t.test_index = m.ma)
SELECT f.athlete, f.first_date, f.first_cm, l.last_date, l.last_cm, ROUND(l.last_cm - f.first_cm, 2) AS change_cm
FROM f JOIN l ON f.athlete = l.athlete
WHERE l.last_cm - f.first_cm < 0
ORDER BY change_cm ASC
